verified_sources.source: National Polygon Dataset technical specification / INSPIRE dataset
facts: National Polygon Shape geometry is mandatory
Poly_ID is a unique spatial-object reference
Title_No uniquely identifies a registered title
UPDATE records date all or part of title was last updated
Rec_Status distinguishes Added Changed Deleted records
INSPIRE polygons are a subset of the wider Index Polygons database
INSPIRE attributes include identifier create date and last-updated date
title number can link polygon records to other HMLR datasets
INSPIRE polygon extent is indicative and not a determined legal boundary
same registered extent can be duplicated across local-authority files

promotion_rule: A candidate polygon must have current active lifecycle semantics and stable title identity before elevation sampling is promoted.
